items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He was giving Joe Adams the lip. He was talking like 'You should get rid of Joe Adams.' ... Joe Adams was his manager.

ctx.x: And he sold the office to a guy that didn't know the business. See, now, he made a mistake on the biggest artists we had. He made a mistake on Ray Charles. Ray Charles was out in Was, I can't think of the guy that wrote up the article... And Ray Charles, he bombed in Was when he played there. He was either high or something was wrong. And the guy gave him a bad writeup. So he called Ray Charles' office, and he was given... Now, he didn't know that Ray Charles' manager was like that. He had Ray Charles on the…
